description: Apply insert/remove/transform/replace/update commands atomically. Environment updates can configure shared 3D cloud layers (density, altitude, wind, colour and quality); see gripforge_scene_schema. Replace preserves id, transform, role, materials and attachments, and rejects incompatible named slots. Locked objects cannot be changed. Scope constrains regional edits; read the schema first.
